name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.CallingPageFullNativeTransActivity
description: When a BNC GIMAC call moves out of its main screen, this Activity keeps the call view connected to the floating meeting window. It lets the user return to the video call after switching to another app.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the call from switching cleanly to or back from the floating view.
